purpose: Confirmation (never-used seeds 3129-3133) of W50N = BC on 64 target rows + 0.5 * BC on 64 uniform source rows + 0.5 * BC on 32 near-set source rows, against T, BC, BCMIX rerun on the same machine and seeds, on the three joint-limit tasks. W50N was selected after seeing j009 (it was a registered arm of j009 but not its candidate). Registered in research/PLAN.md (auto-loop) before submission.

rule.metric: Last5 = mean of the last five evaluation points, 10 episodes each (V21/j004-j009 metric)
rule.strong_control: per task, the group among T, BC, BCMIX with the highest Last5 mean over seeds 3129-3133
rule.confirmed_on_task: W50N Last5 mean over seeds 3129-3133 > strong-control Last5 mean (PLAN section 1 success condition: mean above the strongest control; no significance test)
rule.success: confirmed on BOTH primary tasks (walker2d-kinematic-thighjnt-medium and walker2d-kinematic-thighjnt-hard; the two tasks where W50N was above the strong control by > 1 paired SE in j009) -> PLAN section 1 condition 1 met; loop stops and the user is notified
rule.not_confirmed: otherwise; W50N is not a confirmed method
rule.hopper: hopper-kinematic-legjnt-medium is reported descriptively and does not count toward success (W50N was below BCMIX there in j009)
rule.descriptive: paired difference vs strong control / BCMIX / BC / T with SE and positive-seed count; 1 SE and 2 SE criteria; mean +- SD per group; BCMIX - BC; near-set size; episode lengths
rule.note: Rules fixed before results; not changed after results are seen. Any failed run -> no verdict (failure handling). All seeds kept.

candidate_settings.near_set: source rows with standardized-state nearest distance to target states <= tau; tau = 90% quantile of target leave-one-trajectory-out nearest distances (exactly the rows j005 CG90 removed, the near set of j007)
candidate_settings.loss: mean BC over 64 target rows + a * mean BC over 64 uniform source rows + b * mean BC over 32 near rows
candidate_settings.implementation: worker.py is byte-identical to the j009 worker (same W50N implementation as in j009; its internal seed-derivation prefix 'J009-20261121' is kept unchanged, the run seeds 3129-3133 are new)
